items.title: Joseph Rene Interview, 1960-09-08
items.q: Old Robinson, boy, old Jim. Boy, he's got all the trombone playing by any style of the day.

ctx.x: So he taught your brother wine, huh?

Yeah, he'd give him, yeah, he'd give him, give him some ideas. Yeah, he'd be around him plenty. Old Robinson, boy, old Jim. Boy, he's got all the trombone playing by any style of the day. That's sad. That's something, boy, you... Got some old pictures here, huh? You like that book, huh? Yeah, yeah. Boy, it's fresh in my mouth.

a lot of old things way back, boy. That's a parade outfit here. They never changed a customer costume, bro. They still got the same identity. Still got them white top caps, double-soar handkerchief around them and everything. They ain't done no better than uniform, I tell you. They're the same identical thing they use. Father ain't got a piece of stuff and I tell his wife take on my handkerchief and put some tape around and stick it over the cap. The same way they try to buy a uniform cap. No, indeed, man. The…
